title: Three corners, one straight line
description: On the left, a light blue triangle is outlined in darker blue, with three dashed lines marking off each of its three corners. On the right, a horizontal grey line supports the three separated corner pieces, fitted together side by side with no gaps. Their three pointed tips meet at a single shared point on the line. A green semicircular arc sweeps across all three corner angles, starting from the grey line on the left and ending on the grey line on the right. There are no numbers, symbols, or words in the drawing.

title: Two roads crossing
description: A top-down view shows two straight grey roads crossing each other at an angle that is not a right angle. One road runs horizontally and the other runs diagonally from the lower left to the upper right. Both roads have straight dashed white centre lines passing through the intersection. Two opposite acute angles facing each other across the crossing are shaded in green, each bounded by a matching curved green arc. The remaining two obtuse angles are left plain without fills or arcs. A dark bicycle sits in the upper-left region and a brown wooden two-wheeled cart sits in the lower-right region.

title: The tracing test
labels: 2. Turn it, flip it, slide it.
If it lands exactly, the two figures are congruent.
description: Three panels separated by thin vertical lines show the test for congruence. The first panel contains a right-pointing teal arrow beneath a tilted sheet of tracing paper carrying its grey outline, labelled "1. Trace it." The second panel shows the tilted tracing sheet with the arrow outline and a curved grey arrow showing rotation, labelled "2. Turn it, flip it, slide it." The third panel displays a left-pointing amber arrow inside a grey rectangle, outlined in green, labelled "3. Does it land?" Below the panels, a banner reads, "If it lands exactly, the two figures are congruent."

title: Slide, turn, flip
labels: All three are allowed. The shape is still congruent.
description: Three columns separated by vertical grey lines illustrate transformations of an asymmetrical flag shape. In the first column, labelled "SLIDE", a blue flag points right toward a straight grey arrow and an identical amber flag. In the second column, labelled "TURN", the blue flag is paired with an amber flag rotated about one hundred twenty degrees, connected by a curved grey arrow. In the third column, labelled "FLIP", the blue flag faces a vertical dashed line, with an amber mirror-image flag opposite and an arched grey arrow above. Below, a green box states, "All three are allowed. The shape...

title: Four ways up
description: Four identical wooden chairs in teal are arranged horizontally in a row above a single grey dotted line. The first chair stands upright with its seat extending to the left and its backrest on the right. The second chair lies on its back along the dotted line, with its seat and legs pointing upward and to the left. The third chair rests upside down, with its backrest pointing down and its legs pointing straight up into the air. The fourth chair is upright and mirrored, facing to the right with its backrest on the left.

title: Three things to copy
description: Three objects are arranged vertically in three rows, each paired with a blank yellow square sticky note on its right. In the top row, a round golden-brown chapati sits on a teal circular plate, with a magenta radius line marked from its centre to its outer edge. In the middle row, a rectangular blue notebook has two magenta measurement lines marking its length along the bottom and its width along the right side. In the bottom row, a thick blue tick-shaped symbol has three magenta markings: one dimension line along its short arm, one along its long arm, and an arc marking the elbow angle.

title: The village signpost
labels: Same post, same boards: what do you need to tell the painter?
description: Two vertical brown wooden signposts stand side by side on a tan ground strip. The left post holds three arrow-shaped boards of different lengths pointing in three directions: a long blue arrow angled up to the right, a short amber arrow angled down to the left, and a medium green arrow angled down to the right. The right post has three unpainted rectangular wooden boards without arrowheads, matching the positions, lengths, and angles of the boards on the left post. A text box along the bottom reads, "Same post, same boards: what do you need to tell the painter?".

title: Too big to trace
description: A school corridor with a large wooden triangular frame leaning on the wall, two schoolgirls beside it, one holding a tiny sheet of tracing paper, and a measuring tape, a protractor and scissors on the floor.

title: Two crossings, one triangle
labels: Same three sides. One triangle, two ways up.
description: A teal base AB of six centimetres with a dashed circle of radius four around A and a dashed circle of radius eight around B, crossing at E above and F below. The pale teal triangle ABE and the pale amber triangle ABF are mirror images, with a green fold line along AB.

title: Match the sides, the corners follow
labels: corners that land on each other
Match the sides first. The corners follow.
description: Two congruent triangles appear at different tilts. On the left, a teal triangle has vertices labeled "A", "B", and "C", with one, two, and three tick marks on sides AC, BC, and AB. On the right, an amber triangle has vertices labeled "X", "Y", and "Z", with one, two, and three ticks on sides XZ, YZ, and XY. Three dashed green lines with matching ticks connect the corresponding sides. Below, a green table headed "corners that land on each other" lists "A ↔ X", "B ↔ Y", and "C ↔ Z". At the bottom, a green strip reads "Match the sides first. The corners follow."

title: Three sticks in a bag
labels: Two bags. The same three sticks.
description: Inside a light tan panel sit two open beige cloth drawstring bags and two sets of brown sticks. Beside the left bag, three straight brown sticks lie horizontally in a vertical stack, ordered from longest at the top to shortest at the bottom. To the right of the second bag, three straight brown sticks lie scattered at different angles: one angled downwards to the right, one long stick angled upwards to the right, and one standing nearly vertical. Below the panel, a blue-outlined box reads "Two bags. The same three sticks." No numbers, measurements, or triangles are shown.

title: Match the sides, the corners follow
labels: corners that land on each other
Match the sides first. The corners follow.
description: A teal triangle ABC and an amber triangle XYZ, lying at different tilts, with one, two and three bars on matching sides joined by three dashed green lines. Below, a green table lists A with X, B with Y and C with Z.

title: Shuffle both, or neither
description: Four statements about one pair of triangles in a grid: two green ones with straight arrows and a landed icon, two orange ones with crossed arrows and a crooked icon, above the line Shuffle both, or neither.

title: The courier's label
description: A puzzled courier in uniform holds two parcels whose address labels have the same lines in a different order, while two delivery vans wait at the door pointing in different directions.

title: Three moves, every time
labels: Never reason on a tangled picture. Pull it apart first.
description: Three panels show steps from left to right. The first panel, labelled "1. Pull them apart.", shows a blue and amber kite split down its diagonal by a pink dashed line, with dashed outlines drifting outward along arrows. The second panel, labelled "2. Mark what you know.", displays the separated triangles with matching one-bar, two-bar, and three-bar ticks, and a green badge reading "free side". The third panel, labelled "3. Count.", links the triangles with three green lines below a green circled "3", above "SSS" circled beside "SAS", "ASA", "AAS", and "RHS". A bottom green banner reads "Never...

title: One wall, two rooms
description: A top-down floor plan shows a rectangular room divided corner to corner by a single thick pink wall running from the bottom-left corner to the top-right corner. The diagonal wall splits the rectangle into two right-triangular rooms. The upper-left room is filled with pale blue, containing a darker blue bed with a white pillow and a light blue window on the top wall. The lower-right room is filled with pale yellow, containing an amber bed with a white pillow and a light blue window on the bottom wall. No letters, numbers, or labels appear inside the plan.

title: Three moves, every time
labels: Never reason on a tangled picture. Pull it apart first.
description: A three-panel recipe card: a kite cut along a pink dashed diagonal with the halves drifting apart, the two separated triangles with matching bars and a free side, and the pair joined by three green lines beside a rule menu with SSS circled. A green strip below tells the child to pull it apart first.

title: Told and free
labels: Two columns. Fill in both before you start.
description: An open school notebook with a ruled line down the middle: the left column, headed TOLD, holds two grey pencil lines, the right column, headed FREE, is empty with a pencil resting on it, and four small green badge stickers wait beside the notebook.

title: Zoom does not change an angle
labels: The angles don't change when you make it bigger. The sides do.
description: Two phones side by side with a grey magnifying glass between them. The left screen shows a small triangular road sign with 30, 70 and 80 degrees and a side of 2 cm. The right screen shows the same sign zoomed in, with the same three angles and a side of 14 cm.

title: Things that hinge
labels: The arms stay the same length.
description: A pair of scissors, a folding wooden ruler, a drawing compass and a door seen from above, each half open with a dot at its pivot, above one line of text.

title: The gate that lands twice
labels: Same three measurements. Two different triangles. SSA is not a rule.
description: A horizontal base PQ of six centimetres with a thirty degree line from P. A grey arc of radius four centimetres around Q cuts the line at R and S. A teal triangle PQR and an amber triangle PQS overlap, with a pink arrow between the two positions of the swinging side and a dashed three centimetre perpendicular from Q.

title: Two torch beams
labels: Where do the two beams meet?
description: Two children stand on a dark field a few metres apart with a teal line on the ground between them marked 5 m, each shining a torch up so that the two pale beams cross at one bright green point.

title: Where the roads cross
description: A top-down crossing of two grey roads with dashed white centre lines and a small cycle rickshaw at one corner. One pair of facing angles is filled green with single arcs, the other pair is filled pink with double arcs.

title: Two out of three
description: A split card. Left, headed ANGLES: two solid green angle arcs and a dashed grey third arc with a green arrow. Right, headed SIDES: two solid green segments and a dashed grey third segment with an orange question mark and no arrow.

title: SSA and RHS, side by side
labels: Two landings, same side. Two different triangles.
Two landings, opposite sides. One triangle, flipped.
RHS is SSA with the second landing folded away.
description: Two halves. On the left, headed SSA, an arc of 4 cm cuts a 30 degree ray twice above a base of 6 cm, making two different overlapping triangles. On the right, headed RHS, a base of 4 cm with a right angle at one end and an arc of 5 cm cut the upright line above and below, making two triangles that are mirror images across a dashed fold line.

title: The five that work and the two that don't
labels: The angle is between. Both arms pinned.
Get the third angle. Now it's ASA.
The second landing is just a flip.
Angles fix the shape, not the size.
The gate can land in two places.
In SAS the angle is between.
In ASA the side is between.
In SSA the angle has slipped to the end.
description: A wall chart of seven rows: SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS and RHS with green ticks above a green divider, and AAA and SSA with orange crosses below it, each with a small construction and a one-line reason, and a strip about the middle letter along the bottom.

title: Fold it down the middle
labels: Angles opposite equal sides are equal.
description: Four panels. A tall teal isosceles triangle with the top angle 80 degrees, the same triangle with a dashed pink crease from the top to a right angle at the base, the two halves pulled apart in teal and amber with their three matches ticked in green and RHS between them, and the triangle put back with both base angles arced in green and marked 50 degrees.

title: Equal every way round
description: One teal triangular road sign on a post, drawn three times in a row, each copy turned a further third of a turn, all three looking identical.

title: Twins in the world
labels: Where are the triangles? Which ones are twins?
description: Five flat panels in a row: a glass pyramid, a stone pyramid, a dome, a rangoli star and a bridge truss, each with its repeated triangles tinted teal and amber or outlined in pink.

title: Cards and a tray
description: A wooden tray with three empty compartments, six face-up cards showing only tick marks and angle arcs on the table, and a flat hand holding one more card above the middle compartment.

title: Railway lines
description: A railway track drawn in flat illustration, two teal rails running to the horizon, grey sleepers across them, one pink sleeper with a green arc at each rail on opposite sides, and a signal post at the side.

title: How many ways does it fit?
description: A flat wooden board with three triangular holes in a row, and beside each hole its tile: a scalene, an isosceles and an equilateral triangle.

title: The chase recipe
labels: Two angles known? The third is 180° minus them.
Two sides marked the same? The angles opposite them are equal.
Lines, corners and full turns are free.
Write it on the picture. Go round again.
It is never one hard problem. It is twenty easy ones.
description: A four-step recipe card with a grey border: a triangle with two angles known and a pink question mark, a triangle with two ticked sides and matching arcs, three small pictures of a straight line, a corner and a full turn, and a figure with three green answers and a curling arrow, over a green strip.
